# sleek fixtures

These files were written by hand, not saved by the application. They follow
the save format of sleek 2.0.29 (ransome1/sleek), read from its source:

- `due:`, `t:`, `rec:` and `pm:` (pomodoro count) are plain extension tags
- `rec:` takes `1w` or `+1d` (strict) and `h:1` hides a task
- completion writes `x <completed> <created> ...`
- `crlf.txt` and `no-trailing-newline.txt` model files saved on Windows or
  edited by another tool; sleek reads either ending

The application itself was not run.
